title: Trustworthy Borehole Database Ingestion from VLM Proposals: Provenance and Spatial Support
description: Versioned Paper 4 result-reproduction software package containing the manuscript, supplementary methods, vector artwork, structured result-level inputs, claim-evidence audits, submission checks, rights/linkage sign-off, and deterministic recomputation scripts. Version v1.0.8 corrects final-PDF rendering and publication metadata without changing scientific claims or frozen results. MIT applies to original source code and author-created package metadata only; third-party and source-derived files retain their source-specific terms. The separately released data-v002 companion has mixed source-specific terms and is not covered by a blanket licence.
